sources.source_locator: Business hours and dissemination; Post-acceptance corrections and deletions; FAQ reuse questions
verified_policy_facts: Indexes begin nightly after the business-day filing window; some filings disseminate next business day. Later removals do not update earlier daily/feed/oldload indexes. Full and quarterly indexes incorporate post-acceptance changes on weekly rebuild.
SEC FAQ states government-created and EDGAR public filing content may be accessed and reused, with some exceptions such as stock art.
sources.implementation_inference: One-to-seven-day closed-day reconciliation establishes observed records only. Existing metadata acquisition policy remains unchanged.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Old daily-index absence cannot establish a removal. A successful request is not a real-time coverage attestation; linked dissemination-policy path attempted during research was unavailable.

sources.source_locator: Fair access; FAQ lag time and timestamps
verified_policy_facts: SEC requests declared contact User-Agent and a maximum 10 requests/second in aggregate across machines. Website posting delay is not guaranteed; no timestamp directly identifies first website availability.
sources.implementation_inference: Keep local shared gate, bounded requests and feed publication/observation clocks separate.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: The local gate does not coordinate other machines. RSS mutable offsets cannot certify uninterrupted intervals.

verified_policy_facts: Submission history is available without API keys and includes at least a year or 1000 filings, whichever is more; historical files are linked separately. API data update as filings disseminate, with variable processing lag.
sources.implementation_inference: A bounded issuer-specific repair must follow explicit historical-file pointers and receipt every page/version.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: No whole-universe submission download or full-index route was added. The page was last reviewed April 8, 2025; accessed October 19, 2026.

sources.source_locator: Opening scope notice; Linking to or Copying Information on the FDA Website
verified_policy_facts: The notification index expressly omits some approvals and label changes. FDA website content is generally reusable unless otherwise noted; FDA prefers source links and recommends copying date/source link when copied.
sources.implementation_inference: Metadata index is a discovery route, not an all-approval denominator or validated approval claim.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Review third-party exceptions per item and jurisdiction/purpose. Programmatic limits and timeliness guarantee were not established from these pages.

sources.source_locator: How Do I Use RSS Feeds?
verified_policy_facts: FDA documents a MedWatch safety RSS route; the help page displays a legacy HTTP URL with mixed-case path. It describes safety information.
sources.implementation_inference: Reconfirm actual canonical HTTPS route and redirects before an operator enables the currently disabled feed.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: The configured modern path was not live-polled. A safety feed does not cover all drug approvals or establish adverse-event causation.

verified_policy_facts: The oncology index directs readers to Drugs@FDA for current product approvals and prescribing information.
sources.implementation_inference: Evaluate a separate product/application/action/label route after policy review.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Direct database-page retrieval timed out; endpoint format, pagination, update latency, history completeness and its downstream routes were not verified. No new route approved.

sources.source_locator: Terms and Conditions and About API pages (body unavailable in retrieval)
verified_policy_facts: The official terms and API page URLs resolve, but retrieved text contained only the site shell.
sources.implementation_inference: Preserve the existing metadata-only policy and version-pinned snapshot/change behavior.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Current substantive terms were not verified. No inferred public-domain, bulk-retention, model-processing or redistribution approval.

sources.source_locator: RSS introduction; Use of the Website
verified_policy_facts: Official issuer site describes RSS readers/aggregators and has a bounded release archive. Corporate terms permit certain public documents for noncommercial informational use subject to conditions and restrict other uses.
sources.implementation_inference: Candidate is one issuer only, with fixed endpoint, cap and cadence to be reviewed.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: The XML URL was not exposed by the research reader. Corporate terms define www.beamtx.com; applicability to investor subdomain/provider and commercial/model uses needs review. No inferred feed URL or new configuration.

sources.source_locator: Limitation on Use of Site; issuer release archive
verified_policy_facts: BWXT corporate terms restrict copying, redistribution and incorporation into retrieval systems; content may change or be removed.
sources.implementation_inference: Research links and release-native identifiers support provenance proposals only.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Investor-subdomain terms/provider applicability, RSS endpoint and automated/model/distribution rights remain unresolved.

sources.source_locator: A. Limitations on Scope of Use; effective January 1, 2024
verified_policy_facts: Terms allow reading and RSS retrieval within a restricted scope; storage, aggregation, reproduction/distribution and commercial activities face express restrictions or consent requirements.
sources.implementation_inference: An issuer-linked wire identifier can be provenance evidence; it grants no acquisition or reuse policy to the pipeline.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Any separate licensed feed/agreement and precise model purpose require review. Research did not establish a project licence.

sources.source_locator: General Rules of Conduct; proprietary rights
verified_policy_facts: Terms restrict scraping, systematic retrieval, redistribution and use for software development including AI training, subject to stated permissions and service-specific terms.
sources.implementation_inference: Do not configure a generic scraper or infer rights from a public release or customer attribution.
sources.ambiguity_or_limit: Inference-only processing, the project purpose and any separate licensed service still need explicit review. No licence or approval was obtained.
